'''Dal Rogos''' was an [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Rogos was tracking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']], hoping to capture them and the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who was aiding them in their activities, when he learned of the murder of two obscure [[Miner/Legends|miners]] in [[the Graveyard]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Vaguely aware of an operation being carried out there by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Ragos determined to follow discreetly to prevent any interference in Vader's plans by the Rebels. When he reached the Graveyard, Rogos made contact with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Janus Bonn]]&mdash;who was leading the operation&mdash;and offered his services and information.

==Personality and traits==
Dal Rogos was an undercover [[Spy/Legends|agent]] for the ISB with an moderately successful mission record. He was trained to blend in to his surroundings, wherever he may be sent. At first glance, he seemed to be a personable man, willing to aid a needy stranger if moved to do so. In truth, he was a ruthless and efficient killer and completely loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. As with most in the Imperial ranks, Rogos believed in [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] and disliked contact with non-Human species, though due to the nature of his job forced him to have a working understanding of several alien languages.

Rogos often choose to wear a stylish white turban and the robes of a merchant which could easily conceal his ever-present [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Rogos was an ambitious man, always keeping an eye and ear open for Rebel activity and Rebel sympathizers he could report to his superiors, earning him more favor and a higher status within the ISB ranks. He was also a languages teacher on [[Gendoraan]].
